state_semantics: Capture at generated position g is after consuming token g and is therefore part of the state predicting token g+1.

capture_definitions.resid_pre: input to decoder layer, before input_layernorm/self-attention
capture_definitions.attn_out: self-attention output after o_proj, before residual addition
capture_definitions.resid_post: decoder-layer output after attention and MoE residual additions
capture_definitions.router_logits: linear router logits from normalized MLP input
capture_definitions.router_topk_weights: softmax over top-k router logits (actual mixture weights)
